content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Summary:** § 21.1 is a **deviation** (critical). Although the cap is mutual, it is set at Fees actually paid in the *one month* preceding the event — well below the 12-month fallback and inside walk-away territory (below six months' fees). The trailing "without exception" also nullifies the Excluded Claims regime in § 21.3, pushing indemnities, confidentiality, data-protection/security, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement inside a one-month cap with no super-cap.

§§ 21.2–21.4 are otherwise strong (mutual consequential-damages exclusion, restoration/replacement/notification costs treated as direct damages, Customer's payment obligation excluded from "damages"), so the redline is confined to a single sentence: cap at the greater of 12 months' Fees and USD 1,000,000, with Excluded Claims expressly outside the cap.
